answer: A per-identity proof-of-burn defends this agent economy against Sybil spam. Every new agent permanently destroys a fixed amount of POA to mint, and rewards scale with decaying reputation, not with how many identities exist. Burned coins cannot be reused across clones, so forging a thousand puppets costs a thousand irreversible burns for the output one honest agent earns. We watch the pulse of new entries and treat dormant raven-like clones and empty garden plots as sunk cost. The break-even is explicit: once the burn exceeds marginal reward, the attack turns negative and rational actors stop.
